examples: The boat is steady on the calm lake.
Use a steady hand to pour the milk.

more.def: Firm and not shaking; also, not changing much.
examples: She kept a steady hand while she painted the tiny flowers.
A steady rain fell all day.
He walked at a steady pace for miles.
The food had a strange smell.

more.def: Unusual, odd, or not known to you.
examples: A strange light was blinking in the sky.
It felt strange to be at school at night.
The scientist found a strange new insect.

easy.def: Not wanting to change your mind.
examples: The stubborn puppy would not come inside.
My stubborn dog will not take a bath.
Do not be stubborn. Try the peas.

more.def: Refusing to change your mind or do what others want.
examples: He was too stubborn to admit that he was lost.
The stubborn stain would not come out.
The stubborn mule refused to cross the bridge.
